reuse.reason: Browser transport seam for the Workers-native Session Host. The mounted official session-controller client consumes these typed Remote gateways through the session-adapter; legacy JSON calls validate HTTP status and an explicit result acknowledgement, preserving Host failures rather than inventing success. Projection acceptance uses the actual exported source ProjectionValueStore class because the stable /client entry exports it only as a type. Projection revisions are SQLite-owned monotonic values, separate from chat journal offsets; client clocks never create acknowledgements. Logical streams reuse the unchanged stable-exported Gateway RemoteStream supervisor; only physical socket loss becomes its RemoteStreamCarrierError. Host business and malformed-protocol failures remain terminal, with original codes preserved.
